steps.note: Quintero at the open outer lock, after the player backed her at the briefing and turned Nightshade down twice: the stance line, the arrested-Nightshade line, then she holds her side of the door. A second talk gives only 'Go on. I've got this side.'

said: You said I was right. Now we're both in.
You turned him down twice. I'd have taken the deal. I'm glad you didn't.
He wants you on your own. I'll be on this side of the door.
Go on. I've got this side.
